# spec-bright-website-public

Public hosting repo for [specbright.com](https://specbright.com). GitHub Pages serves from this repo.

**Do not edit this repo directly.** All content here is generated by the deploy workflow in [`spec-bright-website`](https://github.com/dmytro-stasyuk/spec-bright-website) and gets overwritten on every push to `main` there. Make all changes in the source repo.
